# Which of your Etsy listings actually make money?

> Free Etsy profit analyzer: drop in your Payment Account statement and Sold Order Items CSV and get a fee waterfall, profit per listing, Offsite Ads and refund findings. Runs in your browser, the files are never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
